title: History 16: What open means: weights, licences and the ecosystem
hook: Open code, open weights, open data and an open licence are four different things. Sort out which one you have, because one graph can carry several licences.

verified.claim: ComfyUI's LICENSE file is the GNU GPL, version 3.
The dates and clauses given for GPL 3 and AGPL 3 are from the licence texts.
CreativeML Open RAIL-M is dated August 22, 2022, lists banned uses in Attachment A and requires them to be passed on. The licensor claims no rights in output, within limits.
verified.ref: the licence text as hosted by CompVis, fetched 2026-11-01

verified.claim: The OSI's Open Source AI definition names freedoms to use, study, modify and share, and asks for data information, code and weights.
The table in the Lab is our own logic, on those facts.

unchecked: We read only the licences named here, and only as a reader, not a lawyer. Licences for any specific model you use must be read by you.
We make no claim about which released models meet the OSI definition.
The earlier history of how the word open spread through image models is not covered: we didn't check sources for it.
